sta_subject_matches_role.name: sta_subject_matches_role
sta_subject_matches_role.value:
("section_teacher_assignments"."role" = 'subject_teacher' AND "section_teacher_assignments"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("section_teacher_assignments"."role" <> 'subject_teacher' AND "section_teacher_assignments"."subject_id" IS NULL)

generated.as:
CASE WHEN working_days = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE round((days_present::decimal / working_days) * 100, 2) END

attendance_summary_monthly_shape.name: attendance_summary_monthly_shape
attendance_summary_monthly_shape.value: period_type <> 'monthly' OR (month IS NOT NULL AND year IS NOT NULL AND term_id IS NULL)

attendance_summary_term_shape.name: attendance_summary_term_shape
attendance_summary_term_shape.value: period_type <> 'term' OR (term_id IS NOT NULL AND month IS NULL AND year IS NULL)

attendance_summary_annual_shape.name: attendance_summary_annual_shape
attendance_summary_annual_shape.value: period_type <> 'annual' OR (month IS NULL AND year IS NULL AND term_id IS NULL)

attendance_summary_month_range.name: attendance_summary_month_range
attendance_summary_month_range.value: month IS NULL OR month BETWEEN 1 AND 12

grading_scale_bands_bounds.name: grading_scale_bands_bounds
grading_scale_bands_bounds.value: min_marks >= 0 AND max_marks <= 100 AND max_marks >= min_marks

grading_scale_bands_point_range.name: grading_scale_bands_point_range
grading_scale_bands_point_range.value: grade_point IS NULL OR (grade_point >= 0 AND grade_point <= 100)

pass_criteria_grace_caps_present.name: pass_criteria_grace_caps_present
pass_criteria_grace_caps_present.value: NOT grace_marks_allowed OR (max_grace_per_subject IS NOT NULL AND max_grace_total IS NOT NULL)

pass_criteria_compartment_cap_present.name: pass_criteria_compartment_cap_present
pass_criteria_compartment_cap_present.value: NOT compartment_allowed OR max_subjects_for_compartment IS NOT NULL

published_report_cards_annual_current_uq.name: published_report_cards_annual_current_uq
published_report_cards_annual_current_uq.where: is_current = true AND term_id IS NULL

published_report_cards_term_current_uq.name: published_report_cards_term_current_uq
published_report_cards_term_current_uq.where: is_current = true AND term_id IS NOT NULL

student_component_results_value_present.name: student_component_results_value_present
student_component_results_value_present.value: result_status = 'draft' OR is_absent OR is_exempted OR marks_obtained IS NOT NULL OR grade_obtained IS NOT NULL

student_component_results_exemption_type.name: student_component_results_exemption_typed
student_component_results_exemption_type.value: NOT is_exempted OR exemption_type IS NOT NULL
